name: is_case_sensitive comment: 是否区分大小写 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态（active/deprecated） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: translation_vendor comment: 翻译供应商 note: 外部翻译服务商管理，支持 API 对接 columns: - name: vendor_id comment: 供应商ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: vendor_name comment: 供应商名称 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: vendor_type comment: 类型（agency/freelancer/platform） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: contact_email comment: 联系邮箱 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: api_endpoint comment: API对接地址（可空） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: pricing_model comment: 计价模式（per_word/per_hour/fixed） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: avg_turnaround_hours comment: 平均交付时长（小时） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态（active/suspended/terminated） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: vendor_language_capability comment: 供应商语言能力 note: 供应商支持的语言对及报价，用于任务自动分配 columns: - name: id comment: 能力ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: vendor_id comment: 供应商 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source_language_code comment: 源语言 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: target_language_code comment: 目标语言 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: quality_tier comment: 质量等级（standard/professional/premium） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: price_per_word comment: 每词单价 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态（active/inactive） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: translation_quality_score comment: 翻译质量评分 note: 支持人工和自动评分，追踪翻译质量趋势 columns: - name: score_id comment: 评分ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: translation_id comment: 关联翻译记录 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: scorer_type comment: 评分来源（human/auto） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: accuracy_score comment: 准确性评分（1-5） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: fluency_score comment: 流畅度评分（1-5） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: terminology_score comment: 术语一致性评分（1-5） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: overall_score comment: 综合评分（1-5） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: feedback comment: 评价备注 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: scored_at comment: 评分时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: translation to: language type: N:1 label: 目标语言 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.4 - from: translation_job to: language type: N:1 label: 源语言 color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.2 - from: translation_job to: language type: N:1 label: 目标语言 color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.2 - from: translation_job to: translation_vendor type: N:1 label: 指派供应商 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.2 style: dashed - from: translation_job_item to: translation_job type: N:1 label: 归属任务 color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: translation_job_item to: translation type: N:1 label: 关联翻译 color: '#7B1FA2' penwidth: 1.2 - from: translation_memory to: language type: N:1 label: 源语言 color: '#2E7D32' - from: translation_memory to: language type: N:1 label: 目标语言 color: '#2E7D32' - from: glossary_term to: language type: N:1 label: 源语言 color: '#2E7D32' - from: glossary_term to: language type: N:1 label: 目标语言 color: '#2E7D32' - from: vendor_language_capability to: translation_vendor type: N:1 label: 归属供应商 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.4 - from: vendor_language_capability to: language type: N:1 label: 源语言 color: '#1565C0' - from: vendor_language_capability to: language type: N:1 label: 目标语言 color: '#1565C0' - from: translation_quality_score to: translation type: N:1 label: 关联翻译 color: '#E65100' penwidth: 1.4 design_rules: eav_pattern: translation 表采用 EAV 模式（resource_type + resource_id + field_name），一张表存储所有业务实体的翻译内容，按需扩展 resource_type 即可 translation_strategy: 混合策略：核心内容（商品/类目）集中翻译+人工审核，长尾内容（UGC）AI翻译+抽检。source_hash 检测源内容变化，status=outdated 触发重译 language_fk: 翻译关联 language_code（ISO 639-1），不建 locale 实体。BCP 47 locale 在运行时由 language_code + country_code 拼接 translation_memory: 翻译记忆库通过 source_hash 快速匹配历史翻译，match_count 统计复用频率，辅助翻译效率提升 glossary_enforcement: 术语表为强约束：翻译时必须匹配术语表中的标准译法，确保品牌词和行业术语全站一致 vendor_assignment: 翻译任务可指派供应商（vendor_id），也可留空由内部AI处理。vendor_language_capability 记录供应商的语言对能力和报价，支持自动匹配最优供应商 quality_scoring: 质量评分支持人工（human）和自动（auto）两种来源，从准确性、流畅度、术语一致性三个维度打分，overall_score 为综合评分 job_lifecycle: 翻译任务生命周期：pending → in_progress → completed/cancelled。任务条目完成后自动回写 translation 表的 translated_value 和 status audit_fields: 所有实体统一通过数据库层自动维护审计字段（created_by/created_at/updated_by/updated_at），不在 ER 图中逐表重复列出
